# Heart to Heart Crayons

Heart to Heart Stacking Crayons is the amazing stackable crayon set all in one crayon. Each heart has a single colored crayon and is totally interchangeable from the rest. Mix and match the 12 color hearts so you can make your own unique crayon. And each crayon comes with a fine point so you can make all sorts of detailed coloring projects. And for extra fun, you can mix and match crayons with your friends to make all sorts of fun stacking creations. Size - 8.25" long completed

#### Clever Crayons!

"Clever design for providing an assortment of crayon colors in one utensil/tool. Crayons were good quality and held up to use (they didn't break off...). The only draw back for me personally is that it was a bit tedious/tricky to manipulate to quickly change from one color to the next (though my hands are a bit shaky (tremor) so I'm not the best gauge...). My 6-year-old niece had no issues manipulating to change colors. It's very clever, good price point, and nifty to have an assortment in one spot. I would recommend this in a pinch...but I still like my "boxes of 64" (or even "24") for serious coloring projects. :)"

— WNYMm (4/5)
